events.title: Prestige Arrives: Alpha 0.20 Demo Update
events.summary: Alpha 0.20 is live!This update introduces several new features including Prestige. When anomalies are decrypted they reveal some information, and can then be exploited for Prestige Points. You can spend those points at a completely new location. This update also introduces overrides that change how to build out your train network.Along with Prestige, this update adds some other big updates:The Marketing Office (boost the ad boards!)New upgrades and more trains to buyA reworked notification syste

events.title: Patch Notes v.19
events.summary: Alpha 0.19 Patch NotesNew Features- Added an on-screen controls guide during the tutorial that explains camera movement and automatically updates for keyboard and mouse or gamepad controls.- Added a "Giant" UI scale option and improved how menus scale at larger UI sizes.- Added a frame rate limit setting, which defaults to the current monitor's refresh rate.- Added a VSync toggle.- Some point-of-interest options now require their related buildings or stations to be present on the same line befor

events.title: Alpha 0.18 Patch Notes
events.summary: Alpha 0.18 Patch NotesNew Features- The game now continues running while its window is unfocused or in the background.- Added proper junction visuals where rail lines cross without sharing a station.- Updated the early Yellow and Purple Line layouts so their combo station appears during the demo.- Buildings now pulse when they have an upgrade the player can afford.- The end-demo screen now appears after all demo content is completed, even if the anomaly is never interacted with.UI Changes- Darke

events.title: Demo Out Now!
events.summary: You like trains? Good. The demo is live.Grow from a single train line into a sprawling rail network. Pick up passengers, earn resources, unlock new lines, build new stations, and buy lots of upgrades. Thank you to everyone who tested the playtest over the past week. You truly made the demo so much better and this version has some new content you haven't seen yet! If you find any bugs or have feedback on the demo, please jump in in the Discord or fill out the feedback form. We'd love to hear from

events.title: All Aboard - Post #1
events.summary: Welcome to the first I Like Trains Steam community post.We are excited to finally be sharing I Like Trains. We plan to use this space to highlight game updates, announcements, sneak peaks at upcoming features, dev logs, and of course, lots and lots of patch notes. If you are so inclined, feel free to join the discord to get the latest info and help us make this the best game possible. Thank you! Justin and BlakeSuper Gecko GamesJoin the Discord
